# Central Command Throughout the galaxy Central Command is known for having an operating station in countless sectors within the Monachopsis galaxy, each specializing in different departments of work. They primarily act as a security team for hire to protect companies, and stations from threats that may be too difficult to handle. In sector J7 they are specialized for research purposes, and were the first to arrive when the galactic collision began. After solidifying their hold in the sector we decided it would be best to make an agreement, to try and serve both interests without any unnecessary conflicts.
They will be handling and responding to all communications sent out by the station during your shift. Once your shift has ended you will take the shuttle to the Central Command operating station, where those who work in command will debrief, and the rest may unwind as they prepare to head home.
